immutable_ground_truth.statement: The billing queue in us-east experienced a disruption event from approximately June 11 to June 14, 2026, peaking on June 12-13.
On June 12, 2026, new tickets in billing us-east were 244 with p95 first response time of 211 minutes and billing tag share of 0.61.
On June 13, 2026, new tickets in billing us-east were 268 with p95 first response time of 238 minutes and billing tag share of 0.64.
Baseline new ticket volume for billing us-east in the observed period was between approximately 118 and 141 tickets per day.
Baseline p95 first response time for billing us-east in the observed period was between approximately 42 and 51 minutes.
Baseline billing tag share for billing us-east in the observed period was between approximately 0.18 and 0.25.
The note for June 11 states 'export retries started late UTC'.
The note for June 12 states 'billing export stalled'.
The note for June 13 states 'support console missing billing status'.
